verdict.rationale: three.js is an API-first JavaScript library, so its documented programmatic surface is the primary interface. The pack shows scene, camera, renderer, loaders such as GLTFLoader, and controls such as OrbitControls and TransformControls, with machine-readable llms.txt docs for agents. The project also ships a visual three.js editor, but nothing in the pack documents that every editor capability is reachable through the public API, so parity is implied rather than shown. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that editor actions map onto the public API, independent or hands-on confirmation of editor-to-API parity, and per-page static docs (human doc pages are hash-routed).
